name: iam:PutGroupPolicy
description: A principal with iam:PutGroupPolicy can attach inline policies to any group they have this permission on. This is often abused to grant additional permissions by attaching an inline admin policy to a group the caller is a member of.
author: Seth Art

required.description: Target group must be in Resource section; for self-escalation, must be a member of that group

admin: Principal must be a user (not a role)
Principal must be a member of the target group
lateral: Principal must be a user (not a role)
Principal must be a member of the target group

references.title: AWS Privilege Escalation Methods and Mitigation

options.name: GROUP_NAME
options.description: IAM group name to add the inline policy to (must be a group the caller belongs to)

options.name: POLICY_NAME
options.description: Name for the inline policy to add

options.name: VERIFY
options.description: Verify escalation by calling iam:ListUsers after (true/false)
